steps.label: Opponent goals allowed vs. long-run league average
His results vs. our past forecasts

build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many goals the opponent allows compared with the league. Then adjusted for how he has done against our own forecasts: 334 points against 297.1 forecast in his earlier games, shrunk toward no adjustment. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.
